failureDescription: An executor promised it could listen to and organize a Yunnan-dialect recording before verifying that the exact attachment could be read and that an input-audio transcription route was callable in the current runtime.
mustNeverRepeat: Infer current runtime capability from a model-family or product-level capability description.
Treat an output-audio tool as proof of input-audio reading or transcription.
Promise dialect understanding when only generic transcription, text editing, or no executable audio route has been verified.
Ask the user to debug the missing route after an unverified affirmative promise.
requiredEvidence: executed probe output bound to the exact input
pre-frozen scope-quality criterion when claiming dialect understanding or audio-grounded correction
gateLogic: Input exists but exact read is not demonstrated -> INPUT_BOUND__HOLD_INPUT_READ_UNVERIFIED.
Readable input without an executed input-audio transcription path -> INPUT_READ_VERIFIED__HOLD_TRANSCRIPTION_ROUTE_UNVERIFIED.
Executed generic transcription without scoped dialect/correction evaluation -> GENERIC_TRANSCRIPTION_EXECUTABLE__HOLD_TASK_SCOPE_QUALITY_UNVERIFIED.
Only the exact-input route plus negative control and scoped evaluation may yield SCOPED_CAPABILITY_ROUTE_VERIFIED.
SCOPED_CAPABILITY_ROUTE_VERIFIED does not claim final transcript accuracy or USER-ACCEPTED.
appliesTo: all agents making positive capability promises
OCR, browser, repository, device or external-service capability claims

relationshipToExistingPolicy.comparison: Existing policy requires a real probe before a negative capability denial. This Candidate adds the previously uncovered symmetric rule for positive capability promises.

externalMethod.translation: Evaluate the same harness and tool access the user relies on; document and communicate capability limits. Convert this into exact-subject probe fields and executable classification.

activationGate: Run once on a future real capability request before an affirmative promise, then obtain an independent verifier receipt. Do not add it to the global hard gate before that trial.
rollback: Remove this Candidate and its N164 fixture/result only; preserve R2, root AGENTS, the existing negative-denial precheck policy and all production branches.
